articles.headline: Sportsbook liability Joe Burrow overtakes Josh Allen as NFL MVP favorite
articles.description: Bengals QB Joe Burrow has overtaken Bills star Josh Allen as the betting favorite for NFL MVP honors, a development that could prove costly for sportsbooks.
articles.headlineJa: ブックメーカーにとってのリスクに：ジョー・バロウがジョシュ・アレンを抜きNFL MVP最有力候補へ
articles.descriptionJa: ベンガルズのQBジョー・バロウが、NFL MVPの賭け率でビルスのスター、ジョシュ・アレンを抜き最有力候補となった。この展開は、ブックメーカーにとって大きな損失となる可能性がある。
articles.body:
Just around the halfway point of the NFL season, there is a new consensus favorite for league MVP... one that could cause headaches for sportsbooks if he goes on to win the honor for the first time.

After throwing for 16 touchdowns over his last four games, Cincinnati Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is the new favorite for MVP across the sportsbook marketplace, showing +210 odds at DraftKings. He surpassed Buffalo Bills QB Josh Allen (+240), who had been the favorite since the preseason, on Sunday and maintained that lead through Buffalo's victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Monday night.

It's a particularly unsettling development for sportsbooks, who have seen Burrow be one of the most consistently backed players for MVP over the last few campaigns. Before this season, the Bengals signal caller had attracted the most tickets at BetMGM and was considered the only liability among the top-three preseason favorites at Caesars Sportsbook, according to the company's head of football Joey Feazel.

"We have continued to shorten his price as he lights up the scoreboard and strengthens his case each week," Feazel told ESPN over email on Sunday evening. "As of today, Burrow represents one of the best potential outcomes for bettors and one of the more significant liabilities for the book."

Bookmakers may have been counting on Allen to re-take the odds lead on "Monday Night Football," but that did not materialize when he put up a just-ok performance in a defensive battle with Minnesota. Feazel mentioned that the Bills quarterback has attracted plenty of action from bettors, but his short odds throughout the season dictate that he won't be as much of a liability should he win his second MVP award.

"Burrow I would say is the guy that has probably been the most consistently bet since the beginning. There was no time when it looked like he was out of the race and the same goes for Josh Allen," DraftKings director of sports operations Johnny Avello told ESPN. "[Burrow] is not on the plus side for us, but he's not the worst guy for us either."

That honor belongs to Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams, whose odds have fluctuated wildly between brilliant and substandard performances -- such as his four-interception stinker against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday night -- as well as a three-game absence due to injury.

Williams carries 16-1 MVP odds at DraftKings, placing him sixth on the board, but he has amassed a large amount of ticket volume throughout the season, including a leading 12.2% of the bet share at BetMGM; Burrow is currently second at the book at 11.1%.

"Caleb had the most adjustments, as after his injury on the field and getting carted off, it appeared that he was going to be out long term, and that bumped his odds to 80-1 at one point compared to where he sits today," said Feazel. "Williams is the one we would most like to avoid, as bettors have built the largest liability on him among these contenders."

articles.headline: Sources: Jaguars telling teams they aren't trading WR Brian Thomas Jr.
articles.description: The Jaguars plan to keep wide receiver Brian Thomas Jr. through the trade deadline, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：ジャガーズ、WRブライアン・トーマスJr.をトレードしない意向を各チームに伝達
articles.descriptionJa: ジャガーズはトレード期限までワイドレシーバーのブライアン・トーマスJr.を保持する計画であると、関係者がESPNのジェレミー・ファウラーに語った。
articles.body:
JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- The Jacksonville Jaguars have no plans to trade wide receiver Brian Thomas Jr., sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler on Tuesday morning.

The Jaguars have had teams call about Thomas, but they have told those teams they aren't interested in dealing the 2024 first-round pick and he remains part of their offensive plans moving forward, the sources said.

The trade deadline is 4 p.m. ET on Tuesday.

Thomas, the 23rd overall pick in 2024, caught 87 passes for 1,282 yards and 10 touchdowns and made the Pro Bowl as a rookie, but his production has dropped significantly since. Thomas has 58 catches for 824 yards and has more than twice as many drops (10) as touchdown catches (four) in the 22 games since his rookie season.

His target share was 25.3% in 2024, which ranked 11th in the NFL, but it slipped to 16.6% last season and is 9.5% this season. Last Thursday's game against the Baltimore Ravens was the first time in his career in which he wasn't targeted at least once, and he has just 10 catches for 117 yards and two touchdowns in eight games this season.

Thomas was the subject of trade rumors in the spring, but general manager James Gladstone called any reports that they were actively working to unload him "fraudulent claims."

articles.headline: Xavi Simons reveals emotional toll of Spurs ACL injury as return nears
articles.description: Injured Tottenham attacker Xavi Simons has spoken of the anguish he felt watching the club's relegation battle last season, but is working "endless hours" to return for Roberto De Zerbi's side.
articles.headlineJa: シャビ・シモンズ、復帰が近づく中、スパーズでのACL負傷による精神的苦痛を明かす
articles.descriptionJa: 怪我に泣いたトッテナムのアタッカー、シャビ・シモンズは、昨シーズンのチームの降格争いを目の当たりにした苦悩について語ったが、ロベルト・デ・ゼルビ率いるチームへの復帰に向けて「果てしない時間」をトレーニングに費やしている。
articles.body:
Injured Tottenham attacker Xavi Simons has spoken of the anguish he felt watching the club's relegation battle last season, but is working "endless hours" to return for Roberto De Zerbi's side.

Xavi sustained anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) damage during a 1-0 win at Wolves on April 25 which ruled the Netherlands playmaker out of Spurs' final four fixtures along with the World Cup last summer.

However, Xavi, 23, has been ahead of schedule through his rehabilitation and is set to enter phase three of his recovery later in November, which will allow him to resume team training.

Last month, the former Barcelona and Paris St Germain youngster was invited to speak at the Oxford Union and went into detail about his current spell on the sidelines.

Speaking on Oct. 30, Xavi told students: "I had to watch the remainder of the season from my hospital bed and let me tell you it was not easy.

"I felt completely out of control, infuriated because I couldn't contribute and help. I couldn't do a thing. Luckily the boys did their job.

"Mental is just as important as physical. I've had bad moments at night, not even my family know how bad. I've cried, I've wanted so bad to contribute to Spurs, to my national team.

"I read books, I enhanced my knowledge on certain things, I wanted more information, I wanted to stimulate my mind. I wanted calmness in my brain. That was as important as going to the gym every day.

- Tottenham's winning run brought to abrupt end by late Noah Okafor winner

- Leeds condemn 'disgusting' alleged racist abuse of Jayden Bogle after Spurs game

"It's ultimately finding the balance. You can't underestimate the importance of good psychological health. If your brain isn't working, your body isn't working."

ACL ruptures generally have a recovery time of around nine months, but Xavi is in line to feature in first-team training again after the international break.

That would put him back in contact training only seven months after suffering the injury and raises the possibility of a return to competitive action before the nine-month mark at the end of January.

Quizzed during a question-and-answer session about how he plans to return at his best, Xavi said: "My knee has to feel good. I need to feel strong. Right now, I'm on track, I'm getting stronger every day.

"I'm putting in endless hours. I have a great team that has been with me this entire journey. Everyone has a different schedule.

"Everyone's journey is different. For me, I want to come home and only think, 'I can't move my legs anymore,' because I have pushed myself to the limit daily.

"I want to feel tired. That feeling is when I allow myself to rest. That's how I've approached it throughout."

articles.headline: As Jaylen Brown faces the Celtics for the first time, familiar questions linger
articles.description: Jaylen Brown and the Philadelphia 76ers host Jayson Tatum and the Boston Celtics on Tuesday night.
articles.headlineJa: ジェイレン・ブラウンが初のセルティックス戦を迎える中、根深い疑問が残る
articles.descriptionJa: 火曜日の夜、ジェイレン・ブラウンとフィラデルフィア・76ersが、ジェイソン・タトゥム率いるボストン・セルティックスを迎える。
articles.body:
FOR MUCH OF his decade-long career with the Boston Celtics, Jaylen Brown spent time answering questions about his role.

Critics wondered whether he and Jayson Tatum could coexist, speculated about whose team it was. Both players, their teammates and coaches were aware of the narrative.

"The media wants to kind of sometimes write the story that pulls us apart," Brown said in 2021. "But we talk a lot. We don't let it bother us."

So as Brown -- now a Philadelphia 76er after Boston traded him this offseason -- sat at Sixers media day a month ago, a reporter asked him: "Do you guys know who the alpha is?"

There were years of frustration loaded into Brown's smirk and two-word response: "Next question."

Four months into his Sixers tenure, Brown has again fielded questions about his relationship with his former running mate in Boston, partly because of a social media firestorm Brown started. It has led to back-and-forth comments between Brown and Tatum, and a report from NBC Sports and Celtics TV analyst Brian Scalabrine about Brown's "demands" and "trade request" in Boston. Scalabrine later walked back his comments about Brown asking for a trade.

A source with knowledge of the situation told ESPN that there was no truth to the report. 

Instead, the source said, Brown discovered his former team had tried -- and failed -- to trade him to the Milwaukee Bucks while he was on vacation over the summer. The one thing Brown did ask for, the source said, was to be involved in the process of where he was traded. The Celtics ignored the request and sent him 300 miles southwest to Philadelphia.

So Brown finds himself in a familiar position: On a team he didn't choose laden with star power, trying to establish a role that will lead his squad to a title. On Tuesday, he and Tatum will face off for the first time as opponents -- leading the top two teams in the Eastern Conference -- as the Sixers (9-2) take on the Celtics (8-2) (8 p.m. ET, NBC).

Brown has no plans to repair the relationship -- which he said isn't beef but "lamb chops and some gravy" -- with his former co-star.

"There's nothing to talk about. I mean, he's on his side, I'm on my side," Brown said Sunday. "Both of us are trying to win, so it's nothing to talk about. Just check the ball up.

"I love Boston. Boston's a great city. A lot of people I developed a relationship with, but I'm just focused on what's in front of me right now."

BROWN WAS ON a monthlong vacation that spanned China, Africa and Europe when he learned that the Celtics had tried to trade him to the Bucks for Giannis Antetokounmpo.​

Antetokounmpo got traded to the Miami Heat on June 22, and Brown was left wondering about his future in Boston. He let the Celtics know that despite the failed trade he was willing to remain in Boston, but the team informed him he would be dealt anyway, the source told ESPN.

articles.headline: 2026 NFL pass rush, run stop, blocking win rate rankings
articles.description: Our win rate metrics stack the NFL's top teams and players in run blocking, run stopping, pass protection and pass rushing.
articles.headlineJa: 2026年NFL パスラッシュ、ランストップ、ブロッキング勝率ランキング
articles.descriptionJa: ランブロッキング、ランストップ、パスプロテクション、パスラッシュにおけるNFLのトップチームと選手の勝率指標をランキング形式で紹介する。
articles.body:
ESPN Analytics created revolutionary metrics to measure performance in the trenches -- in both the run and pass game -- using player tracking data from NFL Next Gen Stats. And we updated the formula a little bit for 2026 -- see what's new here.

Our pass rush win rate metric tells us how often a pass rusher is able to beat/win his block within 2.5 seconds. Likewise, our pass block win rate metric conveys the rate linemen can sustain their blocks for 2.5 seconds or longer.

In run stop win rate, a defender can earn a win by doing any of the following: beating his blocker so he's in better position to stop the runner; disrupting the pocket or running lane by pushing his blocker backward; containing the runner such that he must adjust his running lane; or recording a tackle within 3 yards of the line of scrimmage. If a defender earns a run stop win, his blocker earns a loss -- and vice versa.

Here are the rankings for each metric for the 2026 NFL season.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal to offload three players, with Atlético Madrid keen
articles.description: Atlético Madrid are one of the main clubs showing an interest in Arsenal midfielder Martín Zubimendi, while Viktor Gyökeres and Mikel Merino could also depart. Transfer Talk has the latest.
articles.body:
The Arsenal trio of Martín Zubimendi, Viktor Gyökeres and Mikel Merino could depart to raise funds for more arrivals, while Barcelona have made an enquiry about signing Bayern Munich center back Jonathan Tah. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Atlético Madrid are one of the main clubs showing an interest in Arsenal midfielder Martín Zubimendi, as confirmed by Diario Sport. There is a good relationship between the two clubs and Los Colchoneros' interest in the 27-year-old stretches back to his time with Real Sociedad, while the Gunners need to offload players to help balance their books. Viktor Gyökeres and Mikel Merino could also leave the Emirates to help Arsenal's finances, according to AS. The trio have all struggled for playing time this season.

- Barcelona have made an enquiry about signing Bayern Munich center back Jonathan Tah, as reported by Sky Sports Deutschland. The Blaugrana are focusing on the 30-year-old ahead of January, with the club's sporting director Deco looking for an experienced defender who can play alongside yoiung Pau Cubarsí and bring stability and leadership qualities. Bayern have little interest in letting Tah leave, especially as he is a key part of their plans and has a contract that runs until 2029, while the Germany international is also not considering a transfer.

- Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur are interested in Real Sociedad striker Orri Óskarsson, according to Calciomercato. The 22-year-old has caught the eye with his performances this season, already having 14 goals and six assists to his name across LaLiga and the Europa League. The Red Devils are interested due to Benjamin Sesko's injury absence, while Spurs are looking for a striker to suit Roberto De Zerbi's style of play. Everton, Brentford and Sunderland are also interested in Óskarsson, while Atalanta have previously been linked, though any offer to sign the Iceland international would need to exceed €20 million.

- Liverpool and Real Madrid are on a growing list of clubs monitoring Brighton & Hove Albion goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen, according to TEAMtalk. The Reds are looking at the 24-year-old as they plan for whenever veteran stopper Alisson Becker departs Anfield, while Los Blancos see the Netherlands international as a possible successor to Thibaut Courtois. Chelsea and Manchester United are also long-term admirers, while Bayern are also tracking his progress having previously made enquiries.

- Juventus are looking at Atlético's Alexander Sørloth, Monaco's Folarin Balogun and Al Qadsiah's Mateo Retegui as they aim to sign a striker in the January transfer window, according to Gazzetta dello Sport. Sørloth in particular is a favorite for Juve, who have held a long-term interest in the 30-year-old. articles.description: United States coach Mauricio Pochettino is the favored candidate to replace Michael Carrick as Manchester United manager, sources have told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: 関係者：キャリックが解任寸前の中、マンUはポチェッティーノ監督に注目
articles.descriptionJa: 関係者がESPNに語ったところによると、アメリカ代表監督のマウリシオ・ポチェッティーノが、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドの監督としてマイケル・キャリックの後任となる有力候補です。
articles.body:
United States coach Mauricio Pochettino is the favored candidate to replace Michael Carrick as Manchester United manager with the club ready to fire the 45-year-old due to growing alarm over the team dropping into the Premier League relegation zone, sources have told ESPN.

The United hierarchy, led by co-chairman Joel Glazer, minority owner Jim Ratcliffe, CEO Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox, is assessing Carrick's position after the club's worst-ever start to a Premier League season left United just one point off the bottom of the table having won once in 10 league games to date.

- Ogden: Ratcliffe chose to appoint rookies at Man United, and it has them facing relegation﻿ fight

While sources have said discussions are ongoing and will continue over the coming days, they have also told ESPN that there is now acceptance that performances and results demand a change of manager.

Pochettino, 54, extended his contract with the U.S. Soccer Federation until 2030 in August after guiding the United States to the round of 16 at the World Cup this summer.

A source told ESPN that the former Tottenham, Chelsea and Paris Saint-Germain coach has an escape clause in his contract with the U.S. for $10 million (£7.4 million), which Man United would have to pay for the Argentine's services.

Former Newcastle manager Eddie Howe is another candidate admired by United bosses. Julian Nagelsmann, who is also currently out of work, is among the options, and Kieran McKenna, who was interviewed for the job in 2024, has supporters at Old Trafford.

But it is Pochettino -- who has interviewed for the United job on three previous occasions -- who is regarded as having the Premier League experience and personality needed to drag United out of danger and revive the club's fortunes.

Carrick signed a two-year contract at United in the summer after guiding the club to Champions League qualification following his arrival as interim manager in January.

Sources have said that United believed Carrick, whose only previous managerial experience was with Championship team Middlesbrough, merited a long-term deal after his success at Old Trafford last season.

But senior figures have been shocked by the drop in performances and results this season. After they gave the former United midfielder time to turn around the situation last month, Carrick has been able to win only one of four games since his reprieve, and sources have said that his prospects are now increasingly bleak.

United are next in action against Liverpool at Anfield on Nov. 22.

- Neville on Carrick's Man United future: 'Ownership don't have a clue'
